chapters.title: Reverse preorder with a prev pointer
chapters.code:
def flatten(root):
    prev = None

    def walk(node):
        nonlocal prev
        if node is None:
            return
        walk(node.right)
        walk(node.left)
        node.right, node.left = prev, None
        prev = node

    walk(root)
